last.verdict: AMD's AI data center business nearly doubled and the fourth-quarter forecast is about $17 billion, but profit margin stays flat near 55%.

takeaways.label: Big fourth-quarter jump
takeaways.text: AMD guided fourth-quarter revenue to about $17 billion, up roughly 66% from a year earlier and far above the $13.4 billion just reported, as Helios AI racks ramp.

takeaways.label: Data center nearly doubles
takeaways.text: Data center sales rose 97% to $8.5 billion and drove revenue to $13.4 billion, up 45%. Revenue topped the high end of AMD's own guidance.

takeaways.label: Margins not expanding
takeaways.text: Gross margin was 56% and is guided to about 55%, a slight dip. The revenue surge is not yet bringing richer profitability.

takeaways.label: Cash flow and gaming weak
takeaways.text: Free cash flow fell to $554M from $1.56B last quarter. Gaming sales dropped 40% to $773M, hurting an otherwise strong quarter.

history.verdict: Solid beat and strong outlook, but the stock had run too far, too fast.

reasons.label: Sky-high expectations
reasons.text: Stock jumped 21% in the five days before the report, so a modest beat wasn't enough.

reasons.label: Flat profit margin outlook
reasons.text: Gross margin guided to 56% for next quarter, unchanged from this quarter's 56%.

reasons.label: Cash flow and AI timing
reasons.text: Free cash flow fell 39% as spending doubled; big Helios AI rack sales come later.
